notes.title: "Alice's World" Steam Page released, the girl hears "your" voice from in front of the screen
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/bcb8ac1e2aa0c4c98220fb152a0303ecce06e954.png[/img]
Alice's World is a story-driven 2D adventure puzzle game.
The girl opens her eyes in a desolate world, and hears "your" voice from in front of the screen.
You can direct her actions, help her solve mysteries, evade dangers, and find a way to leave this place. Of course, you could also choose not to do so, or even worse, deliberately guide her to death... Just kidding, you surely wouldn't do that, right?
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2439560/Alices_World/
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/b49d52caa40ed999c4231937661499124b6de4ac.jpg[/img]
[h2]【Game Features】[/h2]
[list][*]There is no role-playing! You are yourself, sitting in front of the screen, guiding the in-game character.
[*]Explore the stories hidden behind the desolate world, unravel the truth layer by layer.
[*]Exquisite Japanese-style art and full voice acting bring an immersive experience.[/list]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/9e79f45938240209d61449759220516509a38062.jpg[/img][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/4d1759dee13a21b06e099af803e9f7edc449b451.gif[/img][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/ecf8e07845fac84ee2d416a0815515e55ad313e2.jpg[/img]
[h1]【Story Rich】[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/986280/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/766280/

notes.title: "Beyond the Curtains" - Cozy Game Condensing the Stories of Townsfolk
notes.content:
[h2]A Serene Story through the Window[/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/04c81e510aae8a0e3cdf77dfaa950ffdbe94c1b9.gif[/img]
Forget the hustle and bustle of everyday life and immerse yourself in a tranquil story unfolding beyond the window. Leisurely observe the landscapes and passing people through the window, capturing moments of soothing tranquility.


[h2]Poetry of Objects[/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/20d0e62fce455718faeab30038d7f09cfa8d3d77.gif[/img]
Feeling the owner's profound emotions story through the evolving objects in the room.


[h2]Enjoy at Your Own Pace[/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/09dcd9d86538d019a27d52b415639ff54a10e4d2.gif[/img]
Liberate yourself from stress and pressure, taking control of the game's progression at your own pace. With no fear of missing anything, you can savor a delightful healing time.

[h2]Add to Wishlist[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2648940

notes.title: A Light in the Dark Japanese Voice Update Now Live
notes.content:
Thank you to all Steam users who have waited patiently for this! The Japanese voice audio update for A Light in the Dark has been pushed out today. Users who already own A Light in the Dark can enjoy the game with professional Japanese voice actresses voicing the two main heroines of this game. Isn’t it about time to load up the game and enjoy the story of A Light in the Dark once more?

And for everyone who hasn’t picked it up yet, A Light in the Dark will on sale tomorrow at 10am with a 30% discount for one week to promote this major update!

[b]Japanese Voice Cast:[/b]
Older Girl (CV: Kubo Yurika)
Young Girl (CV: Ichinose Kana)

In addition, the A Light in the Dark soundtrack has been added to the official Youtube channel of developer [url=https://www.youtube.com/@CreSpirit_Game]CreSpirit[/url]. For fans of the music, click the link below to add the soundtrack to your Youtube playlist:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLyr9a9FYNbkFjsZsZVZay42YrBDtxppu5]https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLyr9a9FYNbkFjsZsZVZay42YrBDtxppu5[/url]

Please Note: Since this update is based off of the console port, there are some things that users should keep in mind.
[list]
[*]After updating the game, you will be prompted on whether or not to copy over existing save data from the previous version of A Light in the Dark upon starting up the game
[*]If you don’t have any existing save data then this prompt will not appear upon startup
[*]The prompt to copy over existing save data will only appear the first time you start the game after applying the new update
[*]If you select ‘Yes’, the transfer process will start and you will be able to continue playing the game with your existing save data
[*]If you select ‘No’, the transfer process will not happen and you will need to start over with no save data
[*]For further questions or if you need assistance, you can contact us at [url=mailto:service@crespirit.com]service@crespirit.com[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: A Light in the Dark Voice Update
notes.content:
With the recent release of A Light in the Dark on console, a number of users have been wondering as to when the Steam/PC version will be receiving an update with the Japanese text and audio option. It is in fact coming but is being delayed due to ongoing projects that the developers are working on. We'll have more details as soon as we get them. Everyone's patience is greatly appreciated.

A heads up for those of you who missed the announcement, but the Japanese voice actresses, [url=https://www.acen.org/guests/yurika-kubo/]Yurika Kubo[/url] and [url=https://www.acen.org/guests/kana-ichinose/]Kana Ichinose[/url] will appear at Anime Central (May 19 - 21, 2023) this year. In addition, we will be showcasing a demo of A Light in the Dark with the Japanese voice update. If you are planning to attend this year, definitely come on out to see our guests as well as try out the new demo!

For More Information:
Anime Central Website - https://www.acen.org/

notes.title: A Light in the Dark New Ending
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32092444/14fd9f7d9c79932a381438429ffa383642a7bbad.jpg[/img]
[b]A Light in the Dark New Ending![/b]

The newest ending of A Light in the Dark has been finished after a year waiting. We are appreciated for all the support and patient. The new ending is a free update. It can be enjoyed with updated version. In this update, there is not much in it, but the story is what we’ve been thing and considering for a long time. Hope you guys will like it.

[b][hints for new ending][/b]
1. Achieved Endong0. (New ending is available when the main menu been re-new.)
2. Re-play Ending0 and select the hidden option. (Can load the previous data.)
3. Enjoy the ending film.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32092444/18e0028f59bfa197bd4c5f3eec77090c0325f9be.jpg[/img]
As it's obvious to everyone now, we've unfortunately missed our release date for A Light in the Dark. Due to delays on translation and the time it took to add in Steam achievements, we weren't able to make the end of May release. With that said though, the game build is done and will undergo QA testing on our end next week. Barring any other delays, we are aiming for an end of June release.

But while we have you here, let's talk some screenshots.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32092444/b34fb7dbeee34c01d1ef3ab987cc8436d48facee.jpg[/img]
 Here's a screenshot of the BGM mode in the game. It's confirmed that there will be 12 tracks to the game. Next up we have the CG mode screen.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32092444/884f31f05303645eac5707ba0a9b69912edbbfed.jpg[/img]
Things are moving quickly for A Light in the Dark so we should have new updates sooner than later. Stay tuned for more as we get closer to release!
